items.title: 3 Philippine Consumer Staples Stocks To Watch After Inflation Hit 7.8%
items.summary: Inflation in the Philippines has pushed higher again, and that kind of price shock can quietly reshape which stocks feel comfortable to hold and which start to look exposed. Everyday essentials do not disappear from household budgets when costs rise, they just get bought differently. This article walks through three Philippine consumer staples stocks that are closely tied to that story and explains how October’s inflation spike might matter for your portfolio decisions. items.summary: Stock markets in Asia plunged Friday, following a tech-led sell-off in the US on anticipation that newly elected Democratic officials could stymie an AI investment boom that’s driven global stocks to record highs.
